result.response:
I have addressed all review feedback from Claude and fixed the topology issues across all 4 make3d generators and 3D text:

1. **Vertex-for-Vertex Bisector Offsetting ([bisector.ts](file:///Users/pranav/Project%20Folder/WebAPPBuilder/src/core/3d/make3d/bisector.ts))**:
   - Implemented `offsetRingBisector(ring, inset, isHole)` moving each original vertex along its exact inward normal bisector `p + n_bisector * (2 * inset / |n_bisector|^2)` with clamped miter expansion.
   - Preserves 1-to-1 vertex counts across all bevel and concentric inflation levels without the vertex count mismatches caused by boolean polygon clipping.

2. **Watertight Extrusion & Bevels ([extrude.ts](file:///Users/pranav/Project%20Folder/WebAPPBuilder/src/core/3d/make3d/extrude.ts))**:
   - Refactored `extrudeRings` into continuous 1-to-1 lofted quad strips from back cap to front cap.
   - Level 0 of the bevels directly coincides with the ends of the straight walls (eliminating the seam cracks at z = 1 and z = 9), and the caps triangulated with `triangulate()` directly share vertex indices with the final bevel rings.

3. **Concentric Ring Inflation ([inflate.ts](file:///Users/pranav/Project%20Folder/WebAPPBuilder/src/core/3d/make3d/inflate.ts))**:
   - Built the pillow solid from a single shared outline contour at rim z = 0, lofting concentric 1-to-1 bisector rings elevated by SDF heights towards the center.
   - Triangulates only the innermost ring with `triangulate()` and mirrors the quad strips for the back, eliminating overlapping duplicate surfaces and bad edges.

4. **Direct Index Sharing for Flat Cards ([plane.ts](file:///Users/pranav/Project%20Folder/WebAPPBuilder/src/core/3d/make3d/plane.ts))**:
   - Thickness side walls now directly reference front cap (+halfZ) and back cap (-halfZ) vertex indices rather than allocating duplicate wall vertices, resolving the crescent thin-tip edge failure.

5. **Diagnostic Watertight Tests ([make3d.test.ts](file:///Users/pranav/Project%20Folder/WebAPPBuilder/src/core/3d/make3d/__tests__/make3d.test.ts) & [text.test.ts](file:///Users/pranav/Project%20Folder/WebAPPBuilder/src/core/3d/text/__tests__/text.test.ts))**:
   - Added `assertWatertight` helper that checks all triangle edges and reports explicit non-manifold edge counts and vertex coordinates upon failure.
   - All 10 reference shapes across all 4 modes (square, rounded rectangle, circle, L, ring with hole, star, crescent, glyph 'O', glyph 'B', glyph 'S') and text meshes ('SALE', 'Bob', '3D') are closed watertight 2-manifolds.

6. **Documentation**:
   - Written 5-line handoff in [B3-W2-make3d-text.fix1.handoff.md](file:///Users/pranav/Project%20Folder/WebAPPBuilder/DOCS/3D/tasks/B3-W2-make3d-text.fix1.handoff.md).
   - Appended progress entries to [B3-W2-make3d-text.notes.md](file:///Users/pranav/Project%20Folder/WebAPPBuilder/DOCS/3D/tasks/B3-W2-make3d-text.notes.md).
